dedupe_keys.name: odepower ode based power system modelling and stability analysis in python

description: ODEpower is a Python package for building and analysing power system grids described by ordinary differential equations, aimed at converter-rich AC and DC systems. It was published on Zenodo in September 2025 (version 0.9.1) by Robert Annuth, Anton Wichmann and Christian Becker, to offer one interface for graph construction, mathematical tools, simulation and plotting. Features listed are integrated DC and AC ODE models, modular component-based modelling of power electronics and their controls, stability, interaction and modal analysis, time-domain simulation, tools for reading and processing MATLAB Simulink simulations through a MATLAB back end, and a test suite for model validation. Coverage is not tied to a place. The package is downloadable from Zenodo as a ZIP under the GPL 3.0 licence at no cost. Caveats: the Zenodo record links no public repository or documentation, the version is pre-1.0, and the MATLAB back end needs a MATLAB licence. Simulation uses are small-signal stability and control interaction studies of power-electronic grids. Related records: model-power-system-small-signal-tool-manchester and model-issa-stability-analysis cover related stability analysis.
